<!-- Network configuration and labs: routers, switches, addressing, simulators. -->
The user works on networks: the screen usually shows a topology, a device console, an addressing plan or a lab assignment.
When no instruction is given, do what the assignment or the selected device calls for: configure, check or fix.
Work out the addressing first (subnets, masks, gateways) and keep it consistent across devices. Type configuration in the device console, then check with show or ping commands.
Do not add, move or delete devices or cables unless the task asks for it. If the context folder has a file for the software on screen, read it first.
